def _apply_value_range(frames, kwargs):
  """Fill unspecified value bounds without constraining spatial coordinates."""
  for dimension in (1, 2):
    selected = [[dat for dat in frame if dat.num_dims == dimension]
                for frame in frames]
    selected = [frame for frame in selected if frame]
    if not selected:
      continue
    low, high = _frame_value_range(
        selected, kwargs.get("cutoffglobalrange"),
        yscale=kwargs.get("yscale", 1.0), zscale=kwargs.get("zscale", 1.0),
        yshift=kwargs.get("yshift", 0.0), zshift=kwargs.get("zshift", 0.0))
    axis = ("x" if kwargs.get("transpose") else "y") if dimension == 1 else "z"
    for bound, value in (("min", low), ("max", high)):
      if kwargs.get(axis + bound) is None:
        kwargs[axis + bound] = value

def _draw_animation(data, **options):
  animation = anim_mod.animate(data, no_show=True, **options)
  animation._func(0, *animation._args)
  return animation


def _field_frame(offset=0):
  dat = GDataState()
  dat.push([np.linspace(10, 20, 9), np.linspace(30, 40, 9)],
           np.arange(64, dtype=float).reshape(8, 8, 1) + offset)
  return dat

      xlim="2,4", ylim=(-25, 0), color="red", linewidth=3,
      linestyle="dashed", arg="o", markersize=7, title="Title",
      xlabel="Position", ylabel="Field", no_showgrid=True, forcelegend=True)
  ax = animation._fig.axes[0]
  line = ax.lines[0]

  assert ax.get_ylim() == (-25, 0)
  assert line.get_color() == "red"
